content.short: Bitkub is Thailand's largest crypto exchange, licensed by the Thai SEC, with baht trading pairs and QR bank deposits.
content.description: Bitkub is based in Bangkok and licensed by the Thai SEC and the Ministry of Finance. Users fund accounts in Thai baht with a QR transfer that clears in minutes, then trade spot pairs. A broker service offers a longer list of altcoins and meme tokens. Verified accounts have high daily limits, and support runs around the clock in Thai and English. Fully verified accounts can trade up to 50 million baht a day.
content.meta: Thai SEC-licensed exchange with baht pairs, instant QR deposits and 24/7 Thai and English support. Explore Bitkub on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
